ETH.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
Mesob and the solutions for ministries are not stated to use AI.
Breast cancer and coffee disease detection technologies are said to be patented, not to be piloted or in service in a public system.

facts.fact: PM Abiy Ahmed said the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute has released multiple products, including language tools for Amharic, Afan Oromo, Somali, Tigrinya and Afar using speech-to-text, text-to-speech and cross-language conversion built on thousands of hours of audio data.
